The 2026 XPeng MONA M03 has officially launched. This event, themed around youth, appears to be an annual iteration of a key model but actually represents a concentrated shift in XPeng Group's strategy. In a media Q&A session after the launch, He Xiaopeng systematically outlined his views on industry cycles, technological paradigms, profit models, competitive landscapes, and future forms. Behind the name change: The leap from "car manufacturing" to a "physical AI technology group." He Xiaopeng explicitly stated that over the years, external parties have suggested changing the "XPeng" name, but ultimately removing "Auto" indicates a significant expansion of the core business. Over the past decade, XPeng's focus was on intelligent electric vehicles; for the next decade, the focus will be on physical AI, which involves using large models as the foundation to enable perception, understanding, decision-making, and execution in the physical world through entities like cars, robots, and flying cars.

Supporting this judgment is his understanding of the technological pace.

items.title: KV Cache需求暴涨32倍，AI如何重写存储产业链的「旧分工」？| MemoryS 2026观察
items.raw_excerpt: 作者 | 杨依婷 编辑 | 包永刚 去年的CFMS｜MemoryS峰会上，存储厂商们讨论的是：价格何时企稳、QLC何时上量、AI PC何时落地。彼时，“AI会让存储变得更基础、更关键”，还更像是一种行业判断，一种面向未来的趋势预演。 一年之后，站在MemoryS 2026的会场里，问题已经彻底变了。 人们谈论的不再只是位元成本、颗粒供给和容量节奏，而是GPU利用率、token成本、系统调度效率，甚至物理AI场景中的实时决策能力。那些原本属于AI基础设施和系统架构层面的议题，正在越来越频繁地出现在存储产业的讨论中心。 在传统计算架构里，存储的职责更多是“存”。数据被写入、留存，在需要时调取，不需要时则静静停留在系统边缘。它长期是BOM成本中的一项，是容量规划的问题，而很少直接参与算力效率的定义。 但在大模型训练与推理时代，这一角色被彻底改写。 KV Cache的访问延迟，开始直接影响token生成速率；Checkpoint的写入效率，决定着GPU在训练过程中的等待时间；SSD的IOPS密度，则进一步影响大模型推理场景下的并发能力和系统吞吐。 存储开始进入计算主路径，它决定数据流动的速度，也在某种程度上决定GPU算力能否被充分兑现。而这，正在反向重塑整个存储产业链的分工逻辑。 存储进入计算路径，旧分工开始失效 AI推理有一个被反复讨论的瓶颈：KV Cache。 大模型在处理长上下文时，需要把每一层、每一个token生成过程中的Key和Value结果临时保存下来，以避免重复计算。上下文越长，并发越高，这部分缓存的体量就越惊人。 当高带宽显存无法继续承接，KV Cache只能向下一层存储介质下沉，NVMe SSD由此正式进入大模型推理的实时数据路径。 如果说过去SSD的使命是“提升加载速度”，那么在AI时代，它开始直接约束或决定推理吞吐的上限。 慧荣科技总经理苟嘉章的总结更为直接：

excerpt_i18n.zh: 作者 | 杨依婷 编辑 | 包永刚 去年的CFMS｜MemoryS峰会上，存储厂商们讨论的是：价格何时企稳、QLC何时上量、AI PC何时落地。彼时，“AI会让存储变得更基础、更关键”，还更像是一种行业判断，一种面向未来的趋势预演。 一年之后，站在MemoryS 2026的会场里，问题已经彻底变了。 人们谈论的不再只是位元成本、颗粒供给和容量节奏，而是GPU利用率、token成本、系统调度效率，甚至物理AI场景中的实时决策能力。那些原本属于AI基础设施和系统架构层面的议题，正在越来越频繁地出现在存储产业的讨论中心。 在传统计算架构里，存储的职责更多是“存”。数据被写入、留存，在需要时调取，不需要时则静静停留在系统边缘。它长期是BOM成本中的一项，是容量规划的问题，而很少直接参与算力效率的定义。 但在大模型训练与推理时代，这一角色被彻底改写。 KV Cache的访问延迟，开始直接影响token生成速率；Checkpoint的写入效率，决定着GPU在训练过程中的等待时间；SSD的IOPS密度，则进一步影响大模型推理场景下的并发能力和系统吞吐。 存储开始进入计算主路径，它决定数据流动的速度，也在某种程度上决定GPU算力能否被充分兑现。而这，正在反向重塑整个存储产业链的分工逻辑。 存储进入计算路径，旧分工开始失效 AI推理有一个被反复讨论的瓶颈：KV Cache。 大模型在处理长上下文时，需要把每一层、每一个token生成过程中的Key和Value结果临时保存下来，以避免重复计算。上下文越长，并发越高，这部分缓存的体量就越惊人。 当高带宽显存无法继续承接，KV Cache只能向下一层存储介质下沉，NVMe SSD由此正式进入大模型推理的实时数据路径。 如果说过去SSD的使命是“提升加载速度”，那么在AI时代，它开始直接约束或决定推理吞吐的上限。 慧荣科技总经理苟嘉章的总结更为直接：

Author: Yang Yiting Editor: Bao Yonggang

At last year's CFMS | MemoryS Summit, storage manufacturers discussed when prices would stabilize, when QLC would scale up, and when AI PCs would be available. At that time, "AI will make storage more fundamental and critical" was more of an industry judgment, a preview of future trends. 

A year later, at MemoryS 2026, the questions have completely changed. 

The discussions are no longer limited to bit costs, chip supply, and capacity schedules but have expanded to GPU utilization, token costs, system scheduling efficiency, and even real-time decision-making capabilities in physical AI scenarios. Issues originally belonging to AI infrastructure and system architecture are increasingly becoming central topics in the storage industry.

In traditional computing architectures, storage primarily serves to "store." Data is written, retained, and retrieved when needed, otherwise remaining quietly at the periphery of the system. It has long been an item in the BOM cost, a capacity planning issue, rarely directly influencing computational efficiency.

However, in the era of large model training and inference, this role has been completely rewritten. 

KV Cache access latency now directly impacts token generation rates; checkpoint write efficiency determines GPU wait times during training; SSD IOPS density further influences concurrency and system throughput in large model inference scenarios. 

Storage is entering the main path of computation, determining the speed of data flow.

excerpt_i18n.en: No one misses Xiao Bing more than Li Di. "Our company is now called Tomorrow's Journey because I can't call it Xiao Bing; if I could, I would." As the founder of the new company, Li Di still speaks with evident fondness when he mentions the AI product he built from scratch. "Father of Xiao Bing" is Li Di's most well-known identity tag, an AI product to which he has devoted over a decade. However, everything took a sharp turn after the Spring Festival of 2025—first, he was relieved of his duties in February, then in late November, the core product X Eva officially ceased service, forcing Xiao Bing's story into dormancy. It wasn't a graceful farewell. Li Di, along with a core team, turned to the intelligent entity track in December 2025, making a debut at Ji Qi's Creators Forum under the name "Tomorrow's Journey." The team remains small, with fewer than twenty members. We met Li Di twice in Wudaokou, at the end of 2025 and the beginning of 2026. Reflecting on the past, Li Di tries to view and let go of it as an observer, but he still self-deprecates and harbors some regret—"I truly regret only once, not developing the reasoning model at the end of 23." In his recollection, each technical decision corresponds to a window of opportunity: "I may have just lost a name, but Xiao Bing lost a year and a half to two years." From this perspective, the growth path of Xiao Bing, as well as the divergences and choices at critical junctures, can be interpreted differently. excerpt_i18n.es: Nadie piensa más en Xiaoice que Li Di. "Ahora nuestra empresa se llama Mingri Xin Cheng, porque no puedo llamarla Xiaoice, si pudiera, la llamaría Xiaoice". Como fundador de la nueva empresa, Li Di sigue mostrando un claro favoritismo cuando habla del producto de IA que creó. "El padre de Xiaoice" es la etiqueta más conocida de Li Di y el producto de IA al que dedicó más de diez años, pero todo cambió drásticamente después del Año Nuevo Chino de 2025: primero fue destituido de su cargo en febrero, y luego, a finales de noviembre, el producto central X Eva dejó de funcionar oficialmente, forzando a Xiaoice a entrar en un período de letargo. Esta no fue una despedida digna, y Li Di se marchó con un equipo central.

items.title: 豆包APP实时语音通话升级全双工模型 抗干扰与低时延能力提升
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，豆包APP实时语音通话功能升级，上线全双工语音大模型Seeduplex 。据介绍，作为原生全双工端到端语音大模型，Seeduplex 能够在复杂声学场景下实现精准抗干扰与动态判停，提供更顺畅、更自然的语音交互体验。 此次更新后，豆包实时语音通话功能在对话自然度、响应速度和抗干扰能力等方面均有提升。 记者实测发现，升级后的豆包语音通话在复杂环境下表现出较强的抗干扰能力，即便周围存在人声和噪音干扰，也能较准确地识别用户语音，不易被无关声音带偏。以餐厅、展览等易出现多人交谈的场景为例，过往 AI 产品容易因背景噪音或旁人说话声出现误打断、误回复等情况；此次升级后，豆包对无关声音的过滤能力有所增强，对话过程也更不容易被人声意外打断。 除抗干扰能力外，升级后的语音对话节奏也更接近自然交流。人与人对话中，停顿并不总意味着发言结束。此次升级后，豆包可结合语音与语义信息判断用户是否仍在继续表达，从而减少对话中的“抢话”现象。与此同时，对话响应时延也进一步降低，在接龙、飞花令等高频互动场景中表现更为明显。 目前，这一能力已在豆包 APP上线。用户可点击“打电话”按钮，开启实时语音通话功能体验。 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the Doubao app has upgraded its real-time voice call function with the launch of the full-duplex voice model Seeduplex. As a native full-duplex end-to-end voice model, Seeduplex can achieve precise interference resistance and dynamic pause judgment in complex acoustic environments, providing smoother and more natural voice interaction experiences. After this update, the Doubao real-time voice call function has improved in terms of conversation naturalness, response speed, and interference resistance. Journalists found through practical tests that the upgraded Doubao voice calls show strong interference resistance in complex environments, accurately recognizing user voices even with surrounding noise. In scenarios like restaurants or exhibitions where multiple conversations often occur, past AI products have been prone to misinterpreting background noise or other people's voices, leading to interruptions or incorrect responses. With this upgrade, Doubao’s ability to filter out irrelevant sounds has improved, making it less likely for conversations to be interrupted by ambient noise. Besides interference resistance, the rhythm of voice conversations has become closer to natural exchanges. In human conversations, pauses do not always indicate the end of speaking. The upgraded Doubao can now judge whether the user is still expressing themselves by combining voice and semantic information, reducing the "talking over" phenomenon. Additionally, the response latency has further decreased, particularly noticeable in high-frequency interactive scenes like word chain games or poetry recitation. This capability is now available on the Doubao app. Users can click the “Make a Call” button to start the real-time voice call function.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la función de llamada de voz en tiempo real de la aplicación Doubao se ha actualizado con el modelo de voz de doble vía completo Seeduplex. Según la descripción, como modelo nativo de doble vía completo y de extremo a extremo, Seeduplex puede proporcionar una experiencia de interacción de voz más fluida y natural, con precisión para resistir interferencias y detección dinámica de pausas en entornos acústicos complejos. Tras esta actualización, la función de llamada de voz en tiempo real de Doubao ha mejorado en naturalidad de diálogo, velocidad de respuesta y capacidad de resistencia a interferencias. Los periodistas han comprobado que, tras la actualización, las llamadas de voz de Doubao muestran una fuerte capacidad para resistir interferencias en entornos complejos, pudiendo identificar con precisión el discurso del usuario incluso en presencia de voces y ruidos ajenos.

On April 9, SynapX announced it had secured strategic investment from Singapore's K3, with existing shareholders Shunwei, Xiaomi, Hillhouse, and Linear continuing to invest. Founded by Mr. Kuok Meng Xiong, the third generation of the Kuok family, K3 has a forward-looking vision and global deployment capabilities, focusing on global technology innovation investments. Its portfolio includes leading tech companies such as ByteDance, Minimax, Moonshot, OpenAI, SpaceX, Grab, Airwallex, and Airbnb. Additionally, K3 possesses premium industry resources in hospitality and logistics, and has established extensive and efficient commercial networks in Southeast Asia and globally. 

On its long-term journey towards Physical AGI (Physical World General Artificial Intelligence), SynapX adheres to first principles, viewing the home environment as its guiding star and the ultimate test for Physical AI. It focuses on the most generalized, universal, and unrestricted home scenario to drive foundational capability building, product evolution, organizational development, and commercialization pace. The strategic entry of K3 not only brings top-tier international industrial capital but also a vast global resource network and real-world application systems, further expanding the company’s industrial resource base for long-term development. SynapX continues to deepen its focus.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 9 de abril, SynapX anunció haber recibido una inversión estratégica de K3 de Singapur, con los accionistas actuales Shunwei, Xiaomi, Hillhouse y Linear aumentando sus aportes. K3 fue fundada por Kuok Meng Xiong, tercer generación de la familia de Robert Kuok, quien, gracias a su visión avanzada y capacidad de despliegue global, se ha dedicado a largo plazo a invertir en innovación tecnológica a nivel mundial, construyendo una cartera de inversiones de calidad que abarca tecnologías de vanguardia y nuevos sectores económicos, incluyendo ByteDance, Minimax, Moonshot, OpenAI, SpaceX, Grab, Airwallex y Airbnb, entre otros.
